title: The Sleeping Smile
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
